items.title: SK Hynix invests $38B in new plants amid AI memory shortages
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley discusses SK Hynix (SKHY) committing $38 billion to build new chip manufacturing facilities in an effort to scale up production of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and DRAM amid persistent AI supply shortages.
